title: Keep valid Remote Service configuration during temporary Server disconnect
summary: A temporary Agent-to-Server disconnect does not invalidate a Remote Service when required synchronized references are locally resolvable.
rationale: Configuration validity and runtime availability are separate lifecycles, so temporary Server reachability must not destroy valid desired state or endpoint identity.
non_goals: Do not permit unresolved Object or Service references.

sources.note: Explicitly accepted by Rick after architecture review.

alternatives.name: Reject all create/edit operations while Server is unreachable
alternatives.reason: It couples configuration validity to transient runtime reachability.

alternatives.name: Retain valid local desired state and synchronize later
alternatives.reason: It preserves valid intent and stable endpoint lifecycle.

requirements.name: Locally resolvable intent survives Server disconnect
requirements.text: The Agent SHALL retain a valid Remote Service configuration during temporary Server unreachability when every required reference is available in synchronized local metadata.

scenarios.name: Server unreachable with locally available dependencies
scenarios.when: the Agent cannot reach the Server but the destination and Service Object are resolvable from synchronized local metadata
scenarios.then: the configuration is retained as DEGRADED for later synchronization
